title: ever LUSTRE|Embroidered Sequin Ruffle Sleeve Black Tie Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant chiffon gown combines a soft flowing skirt with a delicately sequined lace bodice for timeless sophistication. The sheer flutter sleeves add graceful coverage while enhancing arm movement. Ideal for mothers of the bride or groom, formal evening events, and special occasions where refined elegance shines.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
